ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 85:15 ratio between the high-intensity light-grey/off-white interior surface and the low-intensity black/dark-brown peripheral border and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous light-grey regions across the interior of both lobes. A thick, continuous low-intensity black perimeter band follows the entire trailing and lateral edges. Specific dark linear pixel clusters are mapped at the mid-region of the left lobe and a distinct intersecting 'X' pattern on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central notch with an obtuse interior angle of approximately 140 degrees and a defined vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular profile; trailing edges exhibit jagged variations (peaks and valleys) with pixel-level deviations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels, particularly concentrated at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed from the median notch toward the distal tips, characterized by a tapering geometric expansion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, irregular dark-brown/black pixel groups at the left and right distal tips, indicating calcified surface colonization (barnacles).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two sub-parallel dark linear marks on the mid-left lobe and a prominent intersecting cross-shaped mark (X-pattern) on the mid-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular biological encrustation (barnacles) on the terminal edges of both lobes, creating a non-linear, cauliflower-like perimeter topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and distinct 'X' shaped pigmentation or scar located in the central quadrant of the right lobe.
